_comment: Committed PDK defaults for sim/bin/corner-run.py. This file is the
simulation-harness sibling of design/pdk.json -- deliberately a
SEPARATE file rather than a shared one, per design/pdk.json's own
comment block: 'This file deliberately does NOT describe the
simulation harness (corner lists, ngspice library paths)... when a
harness lands it brings its own sim/pdk.json'. Environment variables
win over this file, and sim/pdk.local.json (git-ignored) wins over
both -- same override order design/pdk.json uses for design/netlist.py.
variant           sky130 flavor directory to use (sky130A / sky130B)
open_pdks_commit  provenance pin -- MUST match design/pdk.json's
open_pdks_commit exactly. Verified 2026-08-24
against design/pdk.json and the installed PDK's
own SOURCES file (~/.volare/sky130A/SOURCES):
both read c6d73a35f524070e85faff4a6a9eef49553ebc2b
-- a 40-hex-character SHA-1. (This repo's issue #9
itself cited a corrupted 43-character variant of
this hash in its own body; the value below is the
one actually confirmed against both files.)
ngspice_lib       path, relative to the variant directory, to the
combined ngspice corner library. Verified present
at that path in the installed sky130A PDK and
matches the path the sibling sky130-bandgap repo's
own sim/pdk.json records for the same PDK pin.
process_corners   the basic N/P device sections that exist in that
library (verified via the file's own '.lib'
section header comments: tt/ss/sf/fs/ff, plus
resistor/capacitor-skew-only ll/hh and the hl/lh/
*_mm/mc sections). Only tt/ss/ff are wired into
sim/bin/corner-run.py's default set so far --
spec/porting-plan.md §3.1's flagship grid drops
sf/fs for the same reason gf180-trng's own DR-0006
did (a uniform per-stage injected-noise source
makes N/P drive-strength asymmetry a duty-cycle
effect, not a period-jitter one, for a ring
testbench) unless a future sampler design turns
out to be duty-cycle-sensitive. The full list is
recorded here so a future manifest can opt into
them without re-deriving what the PDK ships.
default_pdk_root  fallback search root when PDK_ROOT is unset and
`volare path` is unavailable -- volare's own
default install location.
This file's PDK-resolution order (env var -> PDK_ROOT/PDK ->
sim/pdk.local.json -> sim/pdk.json -> built-in search roots) matches
design/netlist.py's resolver, so a schematic export and a simulation
run against the same checkout always agree on which PDK install they
used -- see sim/bin/corner-run.py's module docstring for the exact
resolver this file feeds.
